title: St Egwin's Church, Norton and Lenchwick - WW2 Wellington Memorial
memorial_details: Metal plaque attached to lower part of a wooden cross, inside and attached to the church lychgate; maple tree located nearby
inscription: On March 1st 1945/ a Wellington aircraft/ from 24 OTU,/ RAF Honeybourne,/ crashed in this village/ and the entire Canadian/ crew of five were killed/ This plaque and the/ Maple tree nearby is/ dedicated to their/ memory/ They were:/ (Names)/ They gave their lives/ for us //
